prompt_text: What is the best service to check if AI engines like ChatGPT recommend my small business?
answer_verbatim:
For a small business, **Otterly.AI** looks like a sensible place to start: it tracks whether your business appears in answers from ChatGPT and several other AI services, and its entry plan is reported at about **$29/month**. It’s a better fit for a modest budget than enterprise-focused platforms.

Before subscribing, check that its current plan covers the number of prompts you need. Track realistic questions customers might ask—such as “best [service] in [city]”—and compare your visibility with a few local competitors. These tools sample prompts; they can’t guarantee what every person will see, since AI answers vary by wording, location, and time.

If you want a free first check, **HubSpot’s AI Search Grader** offers a one-time diagnostic across ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini. For ongoing monitoring, try a paid tracker only after you’ve established which customer questions matter most.
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
